Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was born on August 31, 1986.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. is the general manager of the Oklahoma City Blue.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was a video analyst for the Oklahoma City Thunder.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was selected in the first round of the 2008 NBA draft by the Detroit Pistons.
The Detroit Pistons traded Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. to the Seattle SuperSonics on the same day he was drafted.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr.'s rookie season was delayed due to jaw surgery.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. made his professional debut for the Tulsa 66ers of the NBA D-League on March 18, 2009.
In six games with Tulsa, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. averaged 18.3 points and 7.2 rebounds per game.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. made his NBA debut for the Oklahoma City Thunder on April 5, 2009, against the Indiana Pacers.
During his rookie season with the Thunder, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. played in seven games and averaged 8.9 points and 4.6 rebounds.
In the 2009–10 season, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. appeared in eight games for Oklahoma City and averaged 4.8 points and 1.9 rebounds.
In January 2010, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. required surgery to repair a fractured thumb.
After recovering from the surgery, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was assigned to the Tulsa 66ers on March 4, 2010.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. received a standing ovation upon entering the contest during an away game against the Indiana Pacers in March 2010.
During that game, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. scored six points and grabbed two rebounds in 10 minutes of playing time.
For the 2010–11 season, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was retained on the Thunder's 15-man roster.
On October 25, 2010, the Thunder exercised its fourth-year contract option on Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr.
On February 24, 2011, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. and Morris Peterson were traded to the Charlotte Bobcats for Nazr Mohammed.
In September 2012, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed with the Shanghai Sharks of China.
On February 28, 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed a 10-day contract with the Boston Celtics.
On March 10, 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed a second 10-day contract with the Boston Celtics.
On March 20, 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was signed to a multi-year contract by the Boston Celtics.
In July 12, 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was traded to the Brooklyn Nets as part of a deal that brought Kevin Garnett and Paul Pierce to Brooklyn.
On July 18, 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was waived by the Brooklyn Nets.
In September 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. joined the Chicago Bulls for their training camp.
On October 26, 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. was waived by the Chicago Bulls.
In November 2013, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed with the Sichuan Blue Whales for the 2013–14 CBA season.
On March 21, 2014, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed a 10-day contract with the Charlotte Bobcats.
On March 31, 2014, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed a second 10-day contract with the Bobcats.
On April 10, 2014, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed with the Bobcats for the rest of the season.
On October 4, 2014, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed a one-month deal with Laboral Kutxa Vitoria of the Liga ACB.
On November 7, 2014, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. left Laboral Kutxa after his contract expired.
On November 25, 2014, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed with the Fujian Sturgeons of China for the rest of the 2014–15 CBA season.
On July 7, 2015, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. joined the Cleveland Cavaliers for the 2015 NBA Summer League.
On August 26, 2015, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. signed with Auxilium CUS Torino of Italy for the 2015–16 season.
On July 22, 2016, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. re-signed with Auxilium CUS Torino for one more season.
In 2019, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. joined Tofaş.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. averaged 9.2 points, 2.8 rebounds, and 1.3 assists per game with Tofaş.
On August 22, 2020, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. re-signed with Tofaş.
On August 15, 2022, Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. announced his retirement from professional basketball.
Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr. married Brittany and has three children named Timiya, Avery, and Olivia.
